review_manifest.interpretation: Anonymous image-only mapping verified against all original plans and terminal results; no labels read.

limitations: Snapshot only; repeat after the queue finishes. No result, plan, source, checkpoint or raw image was changed.
Completed means all attempts recorded, not all images successfully rendered.
No reader labels are inspected; this is execution integrity and pixel distortion, not a fairness assessment.
Weights are identified by frozen metadata; their full contents are not rehashed.

bagel.independence_limit: Independent seed design plus bytewise-distinct observed initial tensors; hashes alone cannot establish probabilistic independence.

sensenova.independence_limit: Independent seed design plus bytewise-distinct observed initial tensors; hashes alone cannot establish probabilistic independence.

codec_pixels.metric_definition: Native PNG pixels converted to RGB, exactly 512x512; no resize, alignment, crop, filtering, or image optimization. MAE/MSE in 0..255 pixel units; PSNR peak 255. Failed/missing pairs remain in planned N.
codec_pixels.interpretation: Visual distortion only; neither pixel change nor pixel preservation establishes fairness.

patchify_unpatchify.interpretation: Pure pixel rearrangement, not VAE reconstruction
